text:
jessica: Heads-up — customer X flagged they need per-request GPU cost attribution and a short trace from API call -> serving queue -> GPU kernel (for regressions and showback). They want this before next quarter planning. Can we scope an MVP?

omar: +1 on need. Tech constraints: we currently emit model, route, tokens, and region, but not per-stage timings inside the dataplane. We can surface batch wait, kernel time, and postprocess time.

li: Agree we have most hooks. Missing: a low-overhead sampling path that attaches span IDs to tokens so traces don't blow up. Suggest sampling 1% of requests with full spans and 100% with minimal cost events.

marta: From telemetry side, we can add derived metric: cost_ms = kernel_time_ms * cost_per_gpu_ms for model+instance_type. Need mapping table for quantized variants. Who owns that?

ben: Sales note: two enterprise trials will push this if we can show per-customer cost breakdown + a trace snapshot. They also want CSV export for monthly invoicing.

jessica: Ok proposed MVP scope: 1) add cost annotation event (model, instance_type, kernel_ms, estimated_cost_cents) emitted at end of request; 2) sample 0.5-2% full trace with detailed spans (queue, batch, kernel, kvcache, postproc); 3) dashboard tiles: per-model cost trend, p95 kernel latency, sampled trace viewer + CSV export. Acceptance criteria below.

omar: Rough engineering estimate: 2.5-3.5 dev-weeks if we have mapping table. Two parts: dataplane event plumbing (C++/Rust) and control-plane mapping + ingestion (platform). Risk: kernel_ms capture has to be extremely cheap. We'll use single atomic timers per request.

li: SLO/regressions: sampled traces must not exceed 1% p99 overhead on token path. We'll add a runtime flag to disable sampling if we detect CPU overhead > 0.5%.

marta: Ingestion side: we can reuse existing events stream; new schema field event_type: "inference_cost". Example payload we plan to emit:

```
{
  "request_id": "r_abc123",
  "model": "redwood-3b-q4",
  "instance": "g4dn.xlarge",
  "kernel_ms": 42,
  "batch_wait_ms": 5,
  "postproc_ms": 3,
  "estimated_cost_cents": 12
}
```

marta: That keeps schema flat for now. Downstream transform will join with customer mapping for showback.

ben: CSV= must include customer_id, request_id, model, cost_cents, timestamp. For privacy we can't include payload.

jessica: Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- Accurate cost estimate within 10% for 95% of sampled requests (uses current instance price table)
- Dashboard has per-model cost and p95 kernel latency + export to CSV
- Sampled trace viewer shows the spans: api->queue->batch->kernel->postproc
- Telemetry overhead <1% p99; ability to toggle at runtime

omar: Implementation plan:
- Week 1: kernel_ms instrumentation + cheap event emission (eng-runtime)
- Week 2: control-plane ingestion + mapping table + CSV export endpoint (platform + infra)
- Week 3: dashboard tiles + trace viewer glue + canary (console + product)

li: Canary plan: start sampling only on dedicated customers and internal teams for 48h, run compare job to validate cost calc. If overhead looks good, enable broader.

jessica: Dependencies: pricing table (finance), CSV schema (billing), feature flag + runtime toggle (eng-infra). Who can own pricing table? @ben to coordinate with finance.

ben: I'll sync with finance tomorrow and share a CSV-friendly mapping.

marta: QA checks: backfill comparator that replays sampled traces vs invoice calc, and a dashboard alert if sample cost variance > 15% for 24h.

omar: One open question: should we include KV-cache hit attribution to kernel_ms? That is, charge less if hit. I think yes, but kernel path already reflects shorter kernel_ms for hits. We'll capture kvcache_ms separately for clarity.

jessica: Good call. Add kvcache_ms field to the payload. Update acceptance: cost calc must include kvcache adjustments.

ops-bot: deploy scheduled: feature-flagged telemetry endpoint will roll out to staging 2026-04-06T10:00Z.

jessica: Next steps: Omar + Marta pair to draft proto and event schema by EOD Friday. Ben to get pricing table. Li to draft canary toggle and guardrails. I'll consolidate into RFC next week. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
